name: Custom Shape 1-Layer Acrylic Candle Holder with Wooden Base
description:
KEY FEATURES

  • Premium Material:
    - Made from premium clear acrylic and a durable natural wooden base, combining modern elegance with rustic charm.
    - Main acrylic panel thickness: 3mm, offering excellent transparency and durability.
    - Wooden base features a 2-layer construction, each layer measuring 5mm thick for enhanced stability.
    - Smooth laser-cut edges provide a clean, polished finish.
    - Designed to hold standard tealight candles while beautifully displaying personalized artwork securely.
     
  • Sizes & Dimensions:
    - Main Sign Size Options:
             +) 6 × 6 inches ~ 15.24 × 15.24 cm
             +) 8 × 8 inches ~ 20.32 × 20.32 cm
             +) 10 × 10 inches ~ 25.4 × 25.4 cm
    📌 Note: The product dimensions may vary slightly depending on the design, as sizes are not fixed.

 

  • Printing Technology:
    - Finished with UV printing for sharp detail, vibrant color, and a long-lasting decorative surface.
    - Main acrylic panel supports double-sided printing, allowing the artwork to be viewed from both sides.
    - Wooden Base Layer 1 supports double-sided printing.
    - Wooden Base Layer 2 supports single-sided printing.
     
  • Functional & Usage:
    - Combines a personalized acrylic display with a functional candle holder.
    - Designed to hold standard tealight candles for a warm and cozy atmosphere.
    - Personalized with names, photos, quotes, family designs, seasonal artwork, or custom illustrations.
    - Perfect for decorating living rooms, bedrooms, dining tables, fireplaces, offices, and memorial spaces.
    - Freestanding design makes it easy to place on tables, shelves, mantels, or countertops.
    - Adds an elegant decorative touch for everyday home décor or special occasions.
     
  • Perfect Gift for Any Occasion:
    - A thoughtful personalized gift for family, friends, couples, and loved ones.
    - Perfect for birthdays, anniversaries, weddings, and housewarming celebrations.
    - Ideal for Mother's Day, Father's Day, Valentine's Day, Christmas, and other holidays.
    - Meaningful keepsake for memorials, remembrance gifts, and family celebrations.
    - Beautiful decorative piece for patriotic, seasonal, or personalized home décor.
    - A unique combination of personalized artwork and candlelight that creates lasting memories.

 

SPECIFICATION

  • Processing Time: 1 – 3 working days on average after payment, and all designs are updated correctly
  • Shipping Time: 6 – 9 working days on average (US)
  • Packaging: 1x Custom Shape 1-Layer Acrylic Candle Holder with Wooden Base

 

PRODUCTION

  • Manufacturer: Made by Printway
  • Tracking Country Origin is US

 

NOTE

guideLine:
Print Guidelines

 

  • Below is our complete selection of art templates used for designing within the full printable area of our products. 
  • Each template comes with a .png detailing Safe Area, Bleed, etc. 
  • Download templates and mockups here

 

To use an Art Template:

 

  • Open the Printway template for your selected product in Photoshop or another design program.
  • Insert your artwork in a new layer, placing all important parts of your design within the designated “Safe zone” on the art template to ensure your design will not be cut off during the printing process.
  • If you’re designing drinkware, use the indicated centering lines to ensure your artwork is placed exactly where you’d like.
  • Hide or delete the Art Template layer from your file.
  • Save as a .png, .jpg, or another accepted file type.
  • You’ve now used a Printway template to create artwork exactly to the recommended specs for that product.

 

To ensure your design prints properly on each product:

 

  • Ensure all important elements of your design are within the safe zone on the product template.
  • Fill the entire design template! The outer edge of the template represents “Bleed Area,” which signifies the areas which may print on the outer edges of your product.
  • Failure to fill the bleed area will likely result in unprinted white unprinted areas around the edge of your product.
